lane: Bibliography-support fetch for the Circle press release's Wayback capture (bib key circle2023pressrelease)
target: Circle pressroom article "$3.3 Billion of USDC Reserve Risk Removed, Dollar De-Peg Closes" (dateline Boston, March 12, 2023) -- the 'about 8%' restatement of phi and the 77%/23% ($32.4B/$9.7B) reserve-composition split

queries.query: exact-URL CDX for the refs.bib URL as given, full history
queries.result: GAP AT THIS URL: zero captures anywhere near March 2023. Earliest capture is 20241205041647 (2024-12-05), i.e. more than 20 months after the crisis. The refs.bib URL (path '/pressroom/...', slug spelled with hyphens '3-3-billion') did not exist on circle.com in 2023 -- it is a post-redesign URL that keeps the article's original March 2023 dateline in the byline but was not live, and therefore not crawled by Wayback, until Circle's later site restructuring.

queries.query: domain-wide CDX sweep, circle.com, 2023-03-01..2023-04-01, matchType=domain, filter=urlkey:.*press.*
queries.result: DEAD END: the substring filter '.*press.*' matched 'express' (circle.com/en/express, a checkout product page), not any pressroom path -- all 318 rows are /en/express variants. Confirms Wayback's crawl of circle.com in this window used '/en/pressroom/' as the actual press-index path segment, not a bare '/press' or '/pressroom' at domain root reachable by this filter.

Confirms '/en/pressroom' (not bare '/pressroom') was the live 2023 path prefix -- e.g. circle.com/en/pressroom itself (index) has 200-status captures from January 2023 onward, and circle.com/en/pressroom/3 (a numeric-id path) returns 404 on 2023-03-14, showing the section was live and crawled. No row in this listing carries the '3-3-billion' or '3.3-billion' slug near the top rows scanned, which is what prompted the targeted exact-URL retry below with the '/en/' prefix restored.

queries.query: exact-URL CDX, https://www.circle.com/en/pressroom/3.3-billion-of-usdc-reserve-risk-removed-dollar-de-peg-closes (restoring the '/en/' path segment AND respelling the slug with a period, '3.3-billion', matching the bib title's literal '$3.3' rendering, instead of the refs.bib URL's hyphenated '3-3-billion')
queries.result: FOUND. This is the real 2023 URL for the same article (confirmed by title and body-text match, see the fetch note below) -- the refs.bib URL is evidently the modern (2024+) redesigned path/slug for the identical piece, which Wayback never crawled in 2023 under that spelling.

queries.query: domain-wide CDX sweep, circle.com, 2023-03-01..2023-06-01, filter=urlkey:.*deloitte.*  (run opportunistically alongside the pressrelease search to check for any Deloitte-attributed page at all near this window)
queries.result: Zero. Logged here because it is one data point supporting the circle2023attestation gap booked in cdx_search_log_attestation_gap.json.

queries.query: snapshot fetch of the found 2023 capture (raw, id_ suffix)
queries.note: Fetched with curl --compressed (gzip). Decoded HTML's <title> reads '$3.3 Billion of USDC Reserve Risk Removed, Dollar De-peg Closes' -- matches refs.bib's title field verbatim except bib's capitalization of 'De-Peg'. Body dateline paragraph reads 'BOSTON – March 12, 2023 – ...' -- matches refs.bib's howpublished dateline. Confirms this capture is the correct article body, not a redirect or placeholder.
